Name: (CP) Twiistrz New Paths
Author: Twiistrz
Description:
[b]Installation Instructions:[/b][i]
[i]To uninstall, just delete the folder you put in your Mods directory.[/i]

[/i][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract into your [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods\[/b] folder
[*]﻿Run the game using [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[/list][i]
[/i][b]Config Options:
[/b][i]The values are "true" or "false". The default is "true", set to "false" if you wanted to keep the vanilla texture.[/i]

[list=1]
[*][i]StoneFloor[/i] - Config that changes the Stone Floor texture.
[*][i]CrystalFloor [/i]- Config that changes the Crystal Floor texture.
[*][i]StrawFloor [/i]- Config that changes the Straw Floor texture.
[*][i]GravelPath[/i] - Config that changes the Gravel Path texture.
[*][i]WoodPath[/i] - Config that changes the Wood Path texture.
[*][i]CrystalPath [/i]- Config that changes the Crystal Path texture.
[*][i]CobblestonePath [/i]- Config that changes the Cobblestone Path texture.
[*][i]SteppingStonePath [/i]- Config that changes the Stepping Stone Path texture.
[/list]
⚠️ If I didn't credit your work properly please send me a message and I will correct it asap.

⛔️ Copyright / Licensing: If any artist has an issue with pictures please send me a message and the mod will be taken down immediately.
